title: hf-crosstalk: reusable skills for organ-crosstalk ligand-receptor screens
description: Analysis code, result tables and pre-specifications for the heart-failure ligand-receptor screen. Six skills carry their methodological requirements as executable assertions that halt execution on violation. Includes 81 result tables, a log of 264 controls and verdicts, pre-specifications for all three analysis phases, and a figure builder that regenerates all eight figures from the released tables with no network access.
